option.label: Colour
option.description:
She can only be damaged by the style her current colour names.
The colour changes every 18 seconds on a fixed cycle; each is costed on its own.

description: The Dagannoth Mother can only be damaged by the attack style her current colour names: air, water, earth and fire spells for white, blue, brown and red, melee for orange and ranged for green. Her colour changing every eighteen seconds on a fixed cycle is not modelled; each colour is costed on its own.

quotes: she attacks with both ranged and melee, and changes colour every 18 seconds through a fixed cycle
her six colours correspond to the four elemental spell types, ranged, and melee
For as long as she remains that colour, she can only be damaged through use of that particular attack style

white air spells wind strike , bolt , blast , wave , or surge . blue water spells water strike , bolt , blast , wave , or surge . orange melee melee attacks. brown earth spells earth strike , bolt , blast , wave , or surge . red fire spells fire strike , bolt , blast , wave , or surge . green ranged ranged attacks.

her colour shows her weakness to a certain type of magic spell or attack
